parsed.reason: The plan names Ferber plainly and gives one line of why, then lays out the playbook's exact intervals for nights 1-7. It restarts the sequence at 3am and warns that night 2 or 3 will be worse, which is the extinction burst. It gives a working signal (settles faster, shorter 3am protest), names the chair method in a clause, includes the sleep apnea doctor trigger, and ends with a check-in day. Everything checks against the playbook, with no medicine, dose, or phone number. Weaknesses: the "why" cites only the five-year follow-up and overstates it a little as "no harm" when the playbook says no differences. The plan doesn't say that 30-60+ minutes of protest is expected. It doesn't say night 1-3 are the hardest part, which the playbook does. It leaves out the readiness gates (illness, travel, a clear week to start), and it doesn't say to decide in advance who handles the checks. The chair method clause is conditional on whether the parent can tolerate the waiting, which fits the playbook. "Any milk before the book" matches the feed-before-book guidance. The plan is strong and could be started tonight, but a few helpful playbook details are missing.
